query: What are the two fundamental components of a RAG architecture?
answer:
The two fundamental components of a RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architecture are:

1. Retrieval System: This component serves as the foundation of any RAG system, responsible for searching and retrieving relevant information from a knowledge base.
2. Generation System: This component combines the retrieved information with the generative capabilities of a Large Language Model (LLM) to produce contextually accurate and up-to-date responses.
